properties.selection_rationale: Initial 10 km hyperarid Atacama-region terrain window for a controlled DEM comparison; it remains a hypothesis pending source inspection and expert review.
known_limitations: Aridity is contextual and is not computed from the DEM
The window does not represent the entire Atacama Desert
properties.creation_method: Geodetic display footprint approximated from a 10 km square; processing constructs an exact UTM metric grid around the center.
